_comment_purpose: Colosseum voice registry (C4). THIS FILE, not the prose docs, is the authoritative roster of adversarial voices. Every hand-maintained roster site (README, INSTALL, the adversarial/code-adversarial SKILLs, scripts/README, dispatch.config.example.json) is generated from here by scripts/gen_roster_docs.py between explicit markers. Edit a voice here, run `gen_roster_docs.py`, and the doc blocks follow. `gen_roster_docs.py --check` fails CI on drift.
_comment_registry_rule: REGISTRY RULE — calibration is the gate. A voice may hold status 'canonical-panel' only if its `calibration` field is non-pending: it cites a run that actually demonstrated the voice's adversarial fitness. Calibration evidence is required to ENTER the canonical panel AND to LEAVE it (demotion/retirement records the evidence too). A voice that is doc-pinned but has only a dispatchability probe (`opencode run ... "Reply with exactly: ok"`) or a config note is NOT calibrated — it is a 'candidate' with `calibration: pending`. Dispatchability is not fitness. See scripts/colosseum_doctor.py (registry-integrity check) and tests/r0_registry_docs.py (enforced invariant).

voice_fields.id: slug used everywhere as the voice identifier and the `--model` suffix's short name (matches opencode_dispatch.py SLUG_RE). Also the per-section output dir name.
voice_fields.model: full provider/model string OpenCode dispatches, e.g. 'burnt/cloudflare-100/@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6'. For the in-harness Claude voice this is the sentinel 'in-harness' (no OpenCode model string exists).
voice_fields.family: provider/model family for diversity accounting at synthesis time (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / Moonshot / DeepSeek / NVIDIA / Zhipu / Mistral / Alibaba / ...).
voice_fields.harness: opencode | claude-code. 'claude-code' is the in-harness Agent-subagent path (claude-agent only); everything else is 'opencode'.
voice_fields.provider: OpenCode provider key the model routes through (burnt | openai | google | ds4 | lmstudio | null for in-harness). doctor greps ~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc for this.
voice_fields.default_variant: variant passed as --variant when this voice lacks an explicit per-call variant. OpenCode exposes only `high` and `max`, so `high` is its one-below-max setting and is the standing default; `max` is reserved for a deliberate escalation. null means omit the flag.
voice_fields.calibration: evidence reference: the run that demonstrated fitness (or the failure that excluded it), cited to where the repo documents it. The literal string 'pending' means no fitness run is documented yet — allowed ONLY for non-canonical status.
voice_fields.requires_env: list of env var names that MUST be set for dispatch to succeed (provider auth). doctor checks these are present. [] when none.
voice_fields.endpoint: local base URL to TCP/HTTP-probe for reachability (ds4, lmstudio), or null for hosted/in-harness voices.
voice_fields.added: ISO date the voice entered the registry.
voice_fields.retired: ISO date + reason when status became 'excluded' or the voice left service; null otherwise.
voice_fields.notes: auth caveats, gateway quirks, latency, successor models, anything a runner needs before pinning.
voice_fields.omp_model: optional OMP ModelRegistry pattern for the same nominal voice. Absent means no OMP-native route is registered. This is a separate harness route, not evidence that the OpenCode calibration transfers.
voice_fields.omp_calibration: required when omp_model is present. Evidence for this exact OMP-native route, or the literal 'pending'. A pending OMP route may be exercised experimentally but MUST NOT be called calibrated.
voice_fields.omp_thinking_level: OMP thinking level for this voice's omp_model, set one step below that model's maximum on its own ladder (`omp models --json` -> thinking[]). Required when omp_model is present; null means the route exposes no thinking ladder and the dispatch selector carries no `:level` suffix. Dispatch composes `<omp_model>:<omp_thinking_level>`, which overrides the agent wrapper's frontmatter level (OMP resolves effort > selector level > agent frontmatter).

status_values.canonical-panel: in the default milestone panel; REQUIRES non-pending calibration.
status_values.candidate: dispatchable and rostered, but calibration is pending or only partial — eligible to be promoted once a fitness run exists. Doc-pinned voices without a fitness run land here.
status_values.local-specialist: narrow-use local voice (e.g. Lean-only) never in the general adversarial panel.
status_values.excluded: calibration demonstrated unfitness for adversarial spec review; kept here with the reason so it is not re-added by mistake.

profile_fields.name: profile label; a run pins 'panel <name>@<content_hash>'.
profile_fields.voices: ordered list of {id, variant} referencing voice ids above.
profile_fields.content_hash: sha256:<16hex> over the normalized profile (voice id+variant set only; label excluded), computed by scripts/gen_roster_docs.py:profile_content_hash. Recomputed and verified by doctor and tests/r0. A membership or variant change moves the hash, so a pinned 'canonical-4@<hash>' is a frozen, content-addressed panel.

profiles.name: canonical-4
profiles.description: The default milestone panel. Set by operator decision 2026-07-13 as claude-agent (in-harness, Fable 5 or strongest available Opus), gpt-5.6-sol (direct openai provider), glm-5.2 (Fireworks), and kimi-k2.6 (Burnt gateway), all at --variant max. The Moonshot seat changed on 2026-07-26: kimi-k3 (Fireworks) replaced kimi-k2.6 after clearing the pre-registered entry floor and relative bar on a fresh held-out corpus (calibration/2026-07-26-r2). Every member holds cited seeded-recall calibration; the first three at 8/8 on calibration/2026-07-13-r1, kimi-k3 at 7/8 on the harder 2026-07-26-r2 corpus where the incumbent re-baselined at 6/8. Supersedes canonical-5 (memberships pinnable at canonical-5@sha256:19595e6530eb6331 and canonical-5@sha256:63b7c9db3c128174) and the pre-swap canonical-4@sha256:08831d0ce9f2086b. Pin a run as 'panel canonical-4@<content_hash>'. Effort: every seat dispatches one step below its model's maximum thinking level (xhigh for claude-fable-5 and gpt-5.6-sol, high for glm-5.2 and kimi-k3), set 2026-07-26. All cited calibration evidence predates that change and was collected at max, so the panel's recorded fitness describes the max operating point, not the current one.
